This sorghum plot is small, only a small piece of my land, and I planted it together with other crops to feed my family. Sorghum does not get the coupon fertilizer like maize does, and I have no money to buy fertilizer at the market price, so I will not apply any. I will use the seed I kept from last season, as I always do, and I will weed it myself with my hoe. Pesticide and irrigation are not things I use — we wait for the rains here in Mulanje.
